steps.note: Open an existing event that fits the awarding prerequisite: bids are present and bidding is over.
Open the Events list before selecting an existing event.
Verify the Events list and its Create Event control rendered without an error.
Use the History tab to find an event whose bidding has ended and is eligible for awarding.
Verify the selected event is in the closed state required for awarding.
Open the comparison grid to verify that vendor bid data is present for the selected event.
Assert that at least one vendor response exists on the buyer's view.
Verify that awarding has not yet been started and the event exposes the Start Awarding action.
